process.label: How we work
process.title: A clear process, no guessing or unpleasant surprises.
process.subtitle: Throughout the entire project, you know what we're working on, what's next, and how the idea turns into a finished digital product.

steps.title: We get to know your business
steps.desc: At the start, we define goals, audience, content, and the features your project actually needs.

steps.title: We set structure and design
steps.desc: Before development, we align on a clear direction for content, look, and user experience.

steps.title: We develop and test
steps.desc: We build fast, stable, and responsive solutions, with regular communication during development.

steps.title: We launch and stay available
steps.desc: We put the project online, connect the needed services, and provide support after launch.

about.title: A digital partner for companies that want to grow.
about.subtitle: A team that combines strategy, design, and development into solutions with a clear business purpose.
about.statement: PCN is a team from Belgrade that helps companies turn ideas into quality digital products — from presentation websites and online stores to complex web and mobile applications.
about.statement2: We don't build websites just to exist. We build them to clearly present your business, build trust, and make it easier for customers to contact you, book a service, or buy a product.
about.story: For every project, we combine strategy, design, and development so you get a solution that looks credible, works reliably, and can grow with your business. We work with clients from Serbia, Germany, and other markets, with direct communication and a focus on quality delivery.
